components.label: Aligned inputs
components.description: The chosen readings as one observation.
components.details: An observation takes the latest value of every input. A value is used for 3 of its reading's usual intervals and at least 30 s, then the observation is dropped as stale. Hold an input sent only when it changes, so its last value is used until the next one.

fields.name: hold
fields.label: Hold
fields.description: Inputs whose last value stays usable for a set time. Without it, a value is used for 3 of its reading's usual intervals and at least 30 s. Set it for a reading sent only when it changes, such as a setpoint, so it is held until its next value.

fields.name: input
fields.label: Input
fields.description: Id of the input, as in the design's input_slots.

fields.name: seconds
fields.label: Seconds
fields.description: How long its last value stays usable, in seconds.

components.label: Select features
components.description: Keep only the chosen features.
components.details: The features leave in the order they are chosen.

fields.name: features
fields.label: Features
fields.description: The features to keep, in this order.

components.label: Rename features
components.description: Give features new names.
components.details: Distinct names keep branches from colliding where they merge.

fields.name: mapping
fields.label: Mapping
fields.description: The new name of each feature to rename.

components.label: Pass through
components.description: Forward features unchanged.
components.details: Connected to the input, it carries the raw readings past other steps.

components.label: Merge features
components.description: Join branches into one feature list.
components.details: The features follow the order of the connections.

components.label: Smooth
components.description: Average recent values to calm noise, over observations or over time.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>. Leave unset for the step's short name.

fields.name: method
fields.label: Method
fields.description: Exponential weighs recent values more, with alpha = 2 / (window + 1). Rolling takes the plain mean of the window. Time constant weighs values by the seconds since they arrived, so readings every second and every ten are smoothed alike.

fields.name: window_size
fields.label: Window
fields.description: Observations to smooth over.

fields.name: time_constant
fields.label: Time constant
fields.description: Seconds until a lasting change shows to 63% in the result; after three times as long it shows to 95%.

components.label: Despike
components.description: Replace sudden spikes with the recent median.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>. Leave unset for the step's short name.

fields.name: window_size
fields.label: Window
fields.description: Recent observations, an odd number, whose median replaces a spike.

fields.name: threshold
fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: How many scaled median absolute deviations a value may differ from the window median before the median replaces it.

components.label: Change
components.description: Add the change since earlier observations.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>. Leave unset for the step's short name.

fields.name: mode
fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Difference x(t) - x(t - lag), percent change against x(t - lag), or the value lag observations back.

fields.name: lag
fields.label: Lag
fields.description: Observations back to compare with.

components.label: Lags
components.description: Add values from several observations back, such as lags 1 to 3 and 24.
components.details: With the current value beside its lags, a detector that treats observations as unrelated sees how a reading moves over time. Each lag adds one feature per feature used; the step has output once the largest lag has arrived.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Keep the features this step uses and add one feature per lag.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix><lag>, with the unit of a time, as in power_lag15min. Leave unset for lag.

fields.name: unit
fields.label: Unit
fields.description: Count lags in time, which stays right across gaps and readings sent on change: a lag is the last value at or before that long ago. Count them in observations for a series measured at a steady interval.

fields.name: lags
fields.label: Lags
fields.description: How far back, in the unit, such as 1, 2, 3 and 24. Each lag adds one feature per feature used.

components.label: Deseason
components.description: Take out the usual level at this time of day or week.
components.details: Learns each slot of the day or week, such as 14:00 to 15:00, and passes on how far a value lies from it, so a detector sees what is unusual for the time rather than the daily rhythm. With trend it also takes out a slow drift, as STL does. For a daily and a weekly pattern, chain a daily step and a weekly one. It has output once a whole cycle has passed.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses with what is left once their usual level at this time is taken out, or keep them and add it.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>. Leave unset for the step's short name.

fields.name: cycle
fields.label: Cycle
fields.description: The pattern to take out: the same time each day, or each week, where weekdays and weekends differ.

fields.name: slot_minutes
fields.label: Slot in minutes
fields.description: Minutes of the cycle that share one usual level. Shorter slots follow a sharper pattern and need more observations each.

fields.name: memory
fields.label: Memory in cycles
fields.description: How many cycles the usual levels remember. Fewer follow a pattern that changes; more hold steady through an unusual day.

fields.name: timezone
fields.label: Time zone
fields.description: The clock the cycle follows, such as Europe/Berlin, with its daylight saving time.

fields.name: trend
fields.label: Take out the trend too
fields.description: Also follow a slow trend, over about one cycle, and take it out, as STL does, so a series that drifts up or down keeps its usual pattern around the drift.

components.label: CUSUM
components.description: Sum up how far values drift from their usual level, to find a lasting shift.
components.details: A small shift that lasts adds up over observations until it stands out, where a detector of single values misses it. The sum starts over once it passes Reset at, so a rule or detector after it sees one rise per shift.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Keep the features this step uses and add their cumulative sum, or replace them with it.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>. Leave unset for the step's short name.

fields.name: window_size
fields.label: Window
fields.description: Observations the usual level and spread are learned from before the sum starts, and the pace at which they follow later.

fields.name: slack
fields.label: Slack
fields.description: Spreads a value may lie from the usual level without adding to the sum: half the shift you want to find fast.

fields.name: reset_at
fields.label: Reset at
fields.description: Where the sum, in spreads, starts over and the usual level moves to where the series now is, so a lasting shift is found once.

components.label: Rolling statistic
components.description: Add a sum, quantile, spread, trend, shape or score of recent values.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>. Leave unset for the step's short name.

fields.name: statistic
fields.label: Statistic
fields.description: Statistic of the window. std uses n - 1; iqr is the interquartile range; mad is the unscaled median absolute deviation. Quantiles use linear interpolation. Slope is a fitted change per observation. zscore and robust_zscore say how far the latest value lies from the window's mean in standard deviations, or from its median in scaled MADs. rank places the latest value among the window's values, from 0 for the lowest to 1 for the highest. rms is the root mean square; skewness and kurtosis describe the shape, kurtosis as excess over a normal distribution.

fields.name: window_size
fields.label: Window
fields.description: Recent observations the statistic covers.

fields.name: quantile
fields.label: Quantile
fields.description: Quantile to compute, from 0 to 1.

components.label: Math
components.description: Take a log, root, absolute value, square or scale.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>. Leave unset for the step's short name.

fields.name: function
fields.label: Function
fields.description: log needs values above 0, log1p above -1 and sqrt at least 0; linear computes scale * x + offset.

fields.name: scale
fields.label: Scale
fields.description: Factor of linear.

fields.name: offset
fields.label: Offset
fields.description: Constant added by linear.

components.label: Range check
components.description: Clip values to a range, or skip observations outside it.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>. Leave unset for the step's short name.

fields.name: low
fields.label: Low
fields.description: Smallest accepted value; none leaves it open.

fields.name: high
fields.label: High
fields.description: Largest accepted value; none leaves it open.

fields.name: action
fields.label: Action
fields.description: Clip moves values outside the range to its nearest end. Skip drops the whole observation and counts it as a coverage gap.

components.label: Aggregate
components.description: Combine features into their mean, sum, extreme, spread or range.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Keep the features this step uses and add the computed feature, or replace them with it.

fields.name: function
fields.label: Function
fields.description: Computed across the features of each observation; std is the sample standard deviation and range is max minus min.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Name of the computed feature: letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit. Leave unset for the function's name, such as mean.

components.label: Formula
components.description: Compute a feature from others, such as dc_voltage * dc_current.

fields.name: expression
fields.label: Formula
fields.description: Arithmetic over the features arriving here, such as dc_voltage * dc_current, with + - * / ^, parentheses, the functions abs, atan2, ceil, clip, cos, exp, floor, hypot, log, log1p, max, mean, min, mod, round, sign, sin, sqrt and sum, pi, and if(condition, when_true, when_false). Only the chosen branch of if is evaluated. Write a name with other characters between backticks. In a formula for each feature, x stands for that feature.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Name of the computed feature: letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit. Leave unset for formula.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Keep the features the formula reads and add the computed feature, or replace them with it.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: For each
fields.description: Compute the formula once for each of these features, with x standing for the feature, such as x / mean - 1. Leave unset to compute one feature.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: For each feature, keeping features adds <feature>_<suffix>. Leave unset for formula.

components.label: Gate
components.description: Learn and score only while a condition holds.

fields.name: condition
fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Observations where it is false are recorded but neither learned nor scored, such as dc_current > 1. Compare with < <= > >= == != and join with and, or and not.

components.label: Mute alarms
components.description: Raise no alarm while a condition holds.
components.details: Learning and scoring go on, unlike at a Gate.

fields.name: condition
fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Observations where it is true are learned and scored as usual, and an alarm for one of them is kept as muted instead of raised, such as speed < 100. Compare with < <= > >= == != and join with and, or and not.

components.label: Constant
components.description: Add a named constant to use in later steps.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Name of the computed feature: letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit. Leave unset for constant.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value
fields.description: Add this named value to each observation for later steps to use.

components.label: Condition
components.description: Turn a comparison or Boolean condition into a 1 or 0 feature.
components.details: Every observation goes on, unlike at a Gate.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Name of the computed feature: letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit. Leave unset for condition.

fields.name: condition
fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Add 1 when this condition holds and 0 otherwise, keeping the observation. Use comparisons with and, or, not; later steps can read the flag with flag == 1.

components.label: Set feature
components.description: Calculate or replace one feature, keeping the others.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The feature to calculate. An existing one of that name is replaced.

fields.name: expression
fields.label: Formula
fields.description: Compute this feature from the incoming values. Replace only the named feature if it exists, or add it. All other features stay unchanged. Use if(condition, when_true, when_false) to choose a value.

components.label: Accumulate
components.description: Keep a running total, minimum, maximum or count, and start over on a condition.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Keep the features this step uses and add the running value, or replace them with it.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>. Leave unset for the step's short name.

fields.name: function
fields.label: Function
fields.description: Total, minimum, maximum or number of observations since this step's first accepted observation. Restoring a checkpoint continues the accumulation; a new run starts over.

fields.name: reset_when
fields.label: Reset when
fields.description: Start over on each observation where this condition holds, such as dc_current < 1. That observation is the first of the new accumulation. Leave empty to never start over.

components.label: Hold
components.description: Keep each value from the last time a condition held.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Keep the features this step uses and add the held value, or replace them with it.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>. Leave unset for the step's short name.

fields.name: update_when
fields.label: Update when
fields.description: Take the current value on each observation where this condition holds, such as valid == 1, and keep it until the next one. The first observation is always taken.

components.label: Rolling relation
components.description: Add how features move with one other feature: correlation, slope or residual.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Keep the features this step uses and add the statistic, or replace them with it.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>. Leave unset for the step's short name.

fields.name: against
fields.label: Against
fields.description: The feature every other feature is compared with.

fields.name: statistic
fields.label: Statistic
fields.description: Correlation, from -1 to 1, and covariance, with n - 1, say how the feature moves with the other one. Slope is the feature's fitted change per unit of the other one. Residual is how far the latest value lies from that fitted line. A window where either feature stays flat gives a correlation and a slope of 0.

fields.name: window_size
fields.label: Window
fields.description: Recent observations the statistic covers.

components.label: Calculate
components.description: Calculate several named features, one formula per line.
components.details: The lines run in order, so a line can read the features above it.

fields.name: formulas
fields.label: Formulas
fields.description: One feature per line, written name = formula, such as power = dc_voltage * dc_current. Lines run from top to bottom, so a line can read the features above it. A name that already arrives is replaced; a new one is added. Lines that start with # are notes.

components.label: Time features
components.description: Add the seconds since the previous observation, the hour or the weekday.

fields.name: elapsed
fields.label: Seconds since the previous observation
fields.description: Adds dt. The first observation has none before it, so the step is ready after two.

fields.name: hour
fields.label: Hour of day
fields.description: Adds hour, from 0 at midnight up to 24, with minutes as a fraction.

fields.name: weekday
fields.label: Day of week
fields.description: Adds weekday, from 1 for Monday to 7 for Sunday.

fields.name: daily_cycle
fields.label: Daily cycle
fields.description: Adds hour_sin and hour_cos, the time of day on a circle, where 23:59 lies next to 0:00.

fields.name: weekly_cycle
fields.label: Weekly cycle
fields.description: Adds weekday_sin and weekday_cos, the time of week on a circle, where Sunday night lies next to Monday morning.

fields.name: timezone
fields.label: Time zone
fields.description: The clock the hour and the weekday follow, such as Europe/Berlin, with its daylight saving time.

components.label: Standard scaling
components.description: Center and scale with training statistics.
components.details: Means and variances are fitted on the training window and then stay.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>.

fields.name: with_std
fields.label: With Std
fields.description: Divide by the standard deviation. Off only centers each feature.

components.label: Min-max scaling
components.description: Scale to 0 to 1 with training bounds.
components.details: Later values beyond the training bounds leave 0 to 1 unless clipped.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>.

fields.name: feature_range
fields.label: Feature Range
fields.description: The range that the lowest and the highest value seen map to.

fields.name: clip
fields.label: Clip
fields.description: Keep values beyond the bounds at the ends of the range.

components.label: Robust scaling
components.description: Center on the median and divide by the quartile range of training data.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>.

components.label: Centered PCA
components.description: Keep the main directions of the training data.
components.details: Centered principal components, fitted on the training window.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: n_components
fields.label: N Components
fields.description: Features that leave the step. No more than arrive.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.description: Seed for the random choices. Empty uses the design's seed.

components.label: Random projection
components.description: Fewer dimensions through a fixed random map.
components.details: The map follows from the seed alone, so nothing is learned.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: n_components
fields.label: N Components
fields.description: Features that leave the step. No more than arrive.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.description: Seed for the random choices. Empty uses the design's seed.

components.label: Expected value
components.description: Give how far one feature is from what the others imply, by a fit on training data.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Expected from
fields.description: The features the target is expected from. Leave unset to use every other feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the target and the features it is expected from with the residual, or keep them and add it.

fields.name: target
fields.label: Target
fields.description: The feature whose value is expected from the others.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Name of the computed feature: letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit. Leave unset for <target>_residual.

components.label: Online standard scaling
components.description: Center and scale with running statistics.
components.details: Each observation is scaled with the statistics before it, then joins them.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>.

fields.name: with_std
fields.label: With Std
fields.description: Divide by the standard deviation. Off only centers each feature.

components.label: Online min-max scaling
components.description: Scale to 0 to 1 with the bounds seen so far.
components.details: A value beyond the bounds so far leaves 0 to 1 unless clipped.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: suffix

fields.name: feature_range

fields.description: The range that the lowest and the highest value seen map to.

fields.name: clip
fields.label: Clip
fields.description: Keep values beyond the bounds at the ends of the range.

components.label: Online robust scaling
components.description: Center on the recent median and divide by the recent quartile range.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the features this step uses, or keep them and add the step's output as new features.

fields.name: suffix
fields.label: Suffix
fields.description: Added features are named <feature>_<suffix>.

fields.name: window_size
fields.label: Window Size
fields.description: Recent observations per feature for the median and quartiles.

fields.name: min_samples
fields.label: Min Samples
fields.description: Observations per feature before the step is ready.

components.label: Online uncentered PCA
components.description: Keep the main directions, updated as data arrives.
components.details: The components are taken around zero. Center or standardize the features first for a conventional PCA.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Applies to
fields.description: The features this step uses. Leave unset to use every feature.

fields.name: n_components

fields.name: n0
fields.label: N0
fields.description: Observations collected before the first components are set. At least as many as the components.

fields.name: tol
fields.label: Tol
fields.description: What is left of an observation below this size counts as nothing new. Rarely needs changing.

fields.name: forgetting_factor
fields.label: Forgetting Factor
fields.description: Weight of each new observation, between 0 and 1. Empty weighs all observations alike.

components.label: Random projection
components.description: Fewer dimensions through a fixed random map.
components.details: The map follows from the seed alone, so nothing is learned.

fields.description: Features that leave the step. No more than arrive.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.description: Seed for the random choices. Empty uses the design's seed.

components.label: Online expected value
components.description: Give how far one feature is from what the others imply, by a fit updated as data arrives.
components.details: Each observation is compared with the fit before it, then joins it.

fields.name: apply_to
fields.label: Expected from
fields.description: The features the target is expected from. Leave unset to use every other feature.

fields.name: result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Replace the target and the features it is expected from with the residual, or keep them and add it.

fields.name: target
fields.label: Target
fields.description: The feature whose value is expected from the others.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Name of the computed feature: letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit. Leave unset for <target>_residual.

fields.name: forgetting
fields.label: Forgetting
fields.description: How much earlier observations count at every update. 1 weighs every observation alike; 0.999 remembers roughly the last 1,000, so the fit follows slow drift. Below 1, readings that stop varying for long make the fit unstable, so keep 1 for readings that rest.

components.label: Fixed split
components.description: Rank every score against the calibration window, which then stays as it is.

fields.name: fusion
fields.label: Combine detectors
fields.description: How several detectors raise one alarm. Each score becomes a surprise against that detector's calibration scores; max follows the strongest surprise, mean their average. With one detector this has no effect.

components.label: Rolling split CP
components.description: Rank each score against the most recent scores, so the boundary follows slow change. Slow to react to a sudden shift.
components.details: Empirical (1-alpha)(1+1/n) quantile of the last W scores. Valid under exchangeability, slow to react to shifts.
